title: fix: show the info icon on the Apocrypha info button again
summary: In the book picker, the small button next to the **Apocrypha** heading showed the word "info" as plain text instead of the round ⓘ icon. This change brings the icon back. The button should still open the "About the Apocrypha" window, and should still look like a plain icon with no box or background around it.

setup.title: Open the preview build
setup.body: Use the **Open the preview build** button above, in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. If it shows an error or doesn't load, the build may still be finishing: wait a few minutes and reload. If the page still looks like an older version, do a hard refresh: Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, or Cmd+Shift+R on Mac. (On a phone, close the tab and open the link again.)

setup.title: Switch to a translation that includes the Apocrypha
setup.body: Most translations don't include the Apocrypha, so the section won't appear with them. Open the translation menu and pick one that does, such as **KJVA** (King James Version with Apocrypha), or one with "Apocrypha", "Catholic" or "Deuterocanon" in its name. You don't need to sign in for any of these tests. If you can't find a translation with the Apocrypha, mark every test **Blocked** and say so in the notes.

setup.title: For the phone tests
setup.body: A real phone is best. If you don't have one, use your computer's browser in phone mode: press F12 (Cmd+Option+I on Mac) to open the developer panel, then Ctrl+Shift+M (Cmd+Shift+M on Mac) and pick a phone like **iPhone 12 Pro** from the list at the top of the page.

sections.title: On a computer
sections.intro: Use a normal-sized browser window, wider than a phone.

tests.title: The Apocrypha heading shows the ⓘ icon, not the word "info"
tests.why: This is the bug the change fixes.
steps: Click the book and chapter name at the top of the reader to open the book picker.
Open the menu that switches between testaments and choose **Apocrypha**.
expected: The list of Apocrypha books appears under the heading **Apocrypha**.
Right next to the heading is a small round ⓘ icon.
The word "info" does **not** appear anywhere next to the heading.
The icon has no box, border or background behind it, and is the same color as the heading.

tests.title: Clicking the icon opens the About the Apocrypha window
tests.before: Keep the book picker open on the Apocrypha list from the previous test.
expected: When hovering, the pointer turns into a hand.
A window titled **About the Apocrypha** opens, with a paragraph starting "None of the writings in this section were ever considered Scripture…".
The page behind it is dimmed.

tests.title: The window closes with the X, the Esc key, and a click outside
steps: With the **About the Apocrypha** window open, click the close (X) button in its top corner.
Click the ⓘ icon again to reopen it, then press the Esc key.
Click the ⓘ icon again to reopen it, then click on the dimmed area outside the window.
expected: Each time, the window closes and the Apocrypha book list is still showing.

tests.title: The icon works from the keyboard
steps: With the Apocrypha list showing, press Tab repeatedly until the ⓘ icon is highlighted (a focus ring appears around it).
Close the window with Esc, move to the icon again with Tab if needed, and press the Space bar.
expected: Both Enter and Space open the **About the Apocrypha** window.

sections.title: On a phone
sections.intro: On phones, the Apocrypha appears as its own section at the bottom of the full book list, and also in the testament menu.

tests.title: The Apocrypha section at the bottom of the book list shows the ⓘ icon
steps: Tap the book and chapter name at the top of the reader to open the book picker.
Make sure it shows all books (Old and New Testament together), then scroll to the bottom of the list.
expected: An **Apocrypha** heading appears below the New Testament books, with a small round ⓘ icon right next to it.
The word "info" does **not** appear next to the heading.

tests.title: Tapping the icon opens the About the Apocrypha window
steps: Tap the ⓘ icon next to the **Apocrypha** heading.
Read the window, then tap the close (X) button.
expected: A window titled **About the Apocrypha** opens and fits on the screen.
The X closes it, and you're back on the book list.

tests.title: The icon also shows when you pick Apocrypha from the testament menu
steps: In the book picker, open the menu that switches between testaments and choose **Apocrypha**.
expected: The **Apocrypha** heading shows the ⓘ icon next to it, not the word "info".
Tapping the icon opens the **About the Apocrypha** window.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: Dark mode: the icon is still visible and matches the heading
steps: Switch the app to dark mode in its settings.
Open the book picker and show the Apocrypha heading as in the earlier tests.
expected: The ⓘ icon is clearly visible on the dark background, the same color as the heading, with no light box behind it.

notCovered: Translations without the Apocrypha: the change only affects the icon, which never appears for them.
Other languages: the icon is the same in every language, so checking it in English is enough.
